# This workflow will do a clean install of node dependencies, build the source code and run tests across different versions of node
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-nodejs-with-github-actions

name: Build & Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest

        node-version:
          - 22
          - 24
          - 26
        # See supported Node.js release schedule at https://nodejs.org/en/about/releases/
        architecture:
          - x64

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@v5
      - run: ./build_and_test.sh
        shell: bash
        env:
          MISE_NODE_VERSION: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          # Keep isolated installs and npm's cache on the runner's work drive
          # (D: on Windows), rather than the user profile's C: drive.
          TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}
          npm_config_cache: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm-cache
          npm_config_timing: "true"
          npm_config_logs_dir: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm-logs
          npm_config_logs_max: "100"

      - name: Upload npm timing logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: npm-timing-${{ matrix.os }}-node-${{ matrix.node-version }}-${{ matrix.architecture }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm-logs/
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Publish Test Report
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v6
        if: always()
        with:
          report_paths: "**/test-reports/*.xml"
          detailed_summary: true

  auto-merge:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: auto-merge
        if: |
          github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' &&
          github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          ./merge_dependabot.sh
        env:
          PR_URL: ${{github.event.pull_request.html_url}}
          # this secret needs to be in the settings.secrets.dependabot
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{secrets.GH_ACTION_TOKEN}}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check

      - name: Globals inventory is current
